legacy_file_groups.classification: legacy release guides, generated formats, and historical release records
legacy_file_groups.criteria: Candidate for removal from the fresh product documentation surface only after replacement guides are complete and every published/downloaded link is audited. Keep provenance and signed-release facts in an archive or history location; do not imply the old signed APK is the fresh build.

legacy_file_groups.classification: old multi-agent/build3 operating prompts, lane ledgers, and helper scripts
legacy_file_groups.criteria: Retire as active instructions once the fresh rebuild workflow is authoritative; preserve useful evidence and unique technical fixes in current docs/tests first. Delete lane scripts only after checking whether any current workflow still invokes them.

legacy_file_groups.classification: historical build3/build4 handoffs, release steps, reviews, and evidence receipts
legacy_file_groups.criteria: Do not use as fresh-build acceptance evidence. Archive or remove from active onboarding only after important defects/fixes, signed release facts, unique source provenance, and known gaps have been reconciled into the fresh rebuild record. Preserve original audit receipts when needed to explain historical decisions.

legacy_file_groups.classification: prior planning and research for legacy/current-next product iterations
legacy_file_groups.criteria: Review for reusable requirements and evidence, then mark historical or archive. Remove only after replacement evidence is recorded and no source/test/build references depend on these files.

deletion_gate: No file or remote ref is deleted by this inventory.
For a file: identify all incoming links, build/package references, published URLs, and unique facts; migrate needed facts and retain historical provenance before removal.
For a PR: review its full diff and commits; confirm every unique fix is integrated or deliberately rejected with rationale; then close it explicitly.
For a remote branch: confirm no open PR, no downstream branch depends on it, and its useful commits are preserved; obtain repository-owner direction before pruning.
Never include PR #1 or #2 in this build3 cleanup set without separate explicit review because they are independent open work on main.
mutation_status: read-only inventory; no remote mutation, PR closure, branch deletion, or file deletion performed
